component.name: Mount Manager
component.summary: Mount and manage network shares and external drives

description.p: Mount Manager is a small GNOME application that keeps every mounted external path in one place. It lists what is currently mounted, lets you unmount it (even when it is busy), and connects new shares with a few clicks — no terminal, no editing /etc/fstab by hand.

ul.li: SMB / CIFS — Windows shares, Samba and NAS appliances
NFS — versions 3 and 4, with automatic fallback
SSHFS / SFTP — any folder over SSH
WebDAV — HTTP(S) filesystems, including Nextcloud and ownCloud
Local block devices — USB sticks, SD cards, external disks, images
Bind mounts and any other filesystem type
Browses the network (mDNS/Avahi) and lists the shares a server offers
Tests a connection before mounting it and explains failures in plain language
Asks for your password only when root rights are really needed (polkit, with a sudo fallback)
Can mount without admin rights through the user session (GVFS/FUSE)
Optionally writes a safe /etc/fstab entry so shares come back after a reboot, always with a backup
Stores passwords in the GNOME keyring when available
Full command line interface for scripts and headless systems
SMB, NFS, SSHFS, WebDAV, FTP, block device and bind mounts
Network discovery, connection testing, saved shares
Command line interface and Debian package
